reasoning_steps: The text discusses amino acids as the building blocks of proteins and details their chemical and physical properties, classifications, and importance in diet.
Identified core concepts like 'amino acid', 'protein', and classifications of amino acids (essential, non-essential, semi-essential) as distinct classes.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that contains a basic amino group, an acidic carboxyl group, and an organic R group.
classes.comment: An organic molecule that is a building block of proteins.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Protein is a MaterialEntity that is a polymer composed of amino acid residues.
classes.comment: A large biomolecule consisting of one or more long chains of amino acid residues.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An EssentialAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that cannot be synthesized by the body and must be obtained from the diet.
classes.comment: An amino acid that must be supplied through the diet because the body cannot synthesize it.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NonEssentialAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that can be synthesized by the body.
classes.comment: An amino acid that the body can synthesize and does not need to be obtained from the diet.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A SemiEssentialAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that can be synthesized by the body, but not in sufficient quantities.
classes.comment: An amino acid that the body can synthesize, but may require dietary intake under certain conditions.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AminoGroup is a Quality that is a basic functional group containing a nitrogen atom bonded to hydrogen atoms or organic substituents.
classes.comment: A functional group with the general formula -NH2, -NHR, or -NR2.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A CarboxylGroup is a Quality that is an acidic functional group with the formula -COOH.
classes.comment: A functional group consisting of a carbon atom double-bonded to an oxygen atom and single-bonded to a hydroxyl group.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An RGroup is a Quality that is the unique side chain of an amino acid.
classes.comment: The variable side chain of an amino acid that determines its specific properties.
